speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. Please tell me, how long have you been experiencing swelling in your right knee, and does it run in your family?

speaker: Patient
text: 18-month-old boy. The patient is brought in by his parents due to swelling in his right knee noticed after playing in the park. The parents report that there was no obvious injury or incident at the park that could have led to the swelling. Upon further questioning, the mother recalls that an uncle on her side of the family had similar problems, suggesting a possible genetic component.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Hemophilia.

Given the patient is an 18-month-old male with spontaneous right knee swelling after minor activity and a family history on the maternal side, the clinical picture strongly suggests an inherited bleeding disorder, specifically Hemophilia A or B, rather than a traumatic or infectious cause.
